atoms.source_text: The bidder must have an annual turnover of at least ₹50 crore.
To encourage participation by smaller firms, only bidders whose annual turnover does not exceed ₹10 crore are eligible to bid.

findings.explanation: Clauses CL2 and CL5 cannot both hold: CL2 requires turnover >= 50 cr while CL5 requires turnover <= 10 cr.
